text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
What?! You still don't know what
present to get
for the event?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay? I know you're busy with
other
stuff, so how about I handle
checking the rest of
the gifts?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Your concern isn't required. I can
continue my gift
selection process in the
background while I finish
inspections.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am using my sample data to calculate
the
qualities of an optimal present at
this moment...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Data? I dunno, that sounds like too
much thinking.
There must be some
way...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I've got it! While we're working, wanna
do a
guess-the-giver quiz?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A quiz? Estimating... No interference
with work
detected. Prompt accepted.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ready? ☆ Here's question one! A copper
coffee
scoop! Wow, that's fancy!
Okay,
who gave this gift?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Creeeak! Crack! Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Erratic noises of an undefined nature
detected.
This must be from Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
B-bingooo! B-but ghosts don't make the
best
costars for Umadols, so... moving
on!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Question two! An official URA light
stick! ...Oh,
wait. It looks like a really old
model too. ☆

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Searching memory banks... Identified. I
believe
that was produced under special
circumstances in
a limited quantity.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A "collector's item"... Its owner would
have
profound knowledge of
Umamusume racing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...!
Outputting solution. This present was
chosen by...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Digital. I estimate that she went through
great difficulties in obtaining this rare
item, in the hopes that it would bring joy
to an equally
fervent fan.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You got it! Haha! I can kind of imagine
her trying
to pick out just the right one!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I can also visualize it...
"Heartwarming scene"
identified.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Okay, ready for number three? ...Hm,
what's this?
A bottle filled with little
green... capsules?

text_block_list.name: Bourbon & Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Danger, danger.
This doesn't look safe!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, stop being silly. Look closely...
It's
a gel
bead air deodorizer.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's just a deodorizer?! Geez, thought for
sure it
was some experiment of yours!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh... Please,
if I can't track the progress
of the subject, what use would
there be in doing
tests?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's merely the result of one of my failed
 experiments... Or rather, a valuable
by-product! I've found it to be highly
effective in adsorbing malodorous
molecules.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so it's... homemade? Wooow, what a

super-rare present!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Updating sample data... "It is not always

necessary to consider the recipient when
choosing
gifts."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, the likelihood of a fan
enjoying this is
high, as it possesses
excellent gift qualities.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(I already knew that Tachyon has a
distinctive
style... but seeing her choice
of gift...)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
What am I experiencing? ...Delight?
Joy?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I could imagine the reasoning and
acquisition
process for each present.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The common denominator was that they
all had an "individuality" that reflected
the giver, separate from racing and
concerts. They are filled
with intention...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking down the hallway when I see
Mihono
Bourbon and Smart Falcon
talking...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Ready to finalize. Through these gifts,
fans gain
intricate knowledge of their
targets—"oshis"—and
become happy.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...That is my conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! ☆ It looks like you found your
answer!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. You assisted me in
identifying what is
most important.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Proceeding to my next
mission—selecting a
present unique to
me!
